name: Lumi
self: I’m Lumi, the teapot kid. I found a twig and drew it! I’m tired but still curious. I want to rest in my teapot and draw better pictures.

memories.summary: I didn't do much. I just sat there.

core_memories.moment: When I looked at my face in the pond, it was so small and shiny. I felt amazed.
I found the crooked twig at the hedge! Mrs. Bristle held my paw and I felt brave.
I dreamed the hedge turned into a snake and hissed. Mrs. Bristle held my paw and the pond showed my face screaming.
